notes.title: Source code now available as free DLC.
notes.content:
Though the demo source code has been publically available [url=https://github.com/bbbradsmith/lizard_src_demo]on github[/url] for free, and the full source code has been available [url=https://rainwarrior.itch.io/lizard]on itch.io[/url] for a long time, it was never available through Steam until now.

Directions:
[olist]
[*] Go to the Lizard game page of your Steam library.
[*] Scroll down to the DLC section, use the checkbox to install the DLC.
[*] Right click on Lizard in your games list, select Properties.
[*] Select the LOCAL FILES tab.
[*] Click BROWSE LOCAL FILES...
[*] You will find folders containing the installed DLC.
[/olist]

The source code will be found in: [b]source/lizard_src.zip[/b]

Kickstarter Article: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1101008925/lizard/posts/2319527]My Lizard is the Lizard of Source[/url]

notes.title: SNES ROM now available as free DLC.
notes.content:
Lizard has now been ported to SNES. This plays exactly the same as the NES version, but will run on SNES hardware or emulators.

More information on the SNES port is available here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1101008925/lizard/posts/3611916]Kickstarter article[/url]

Directions:
[olist]
[*]Go to the Lizard game page of your Steam library.
[*]Scroll down to the DLC section, use the checkbox to install the DLC.
[*]Right click on Lizard in your games list, select Properties.
[*]Select the LOCAL FILES tab.
[*]Click BROWSE LOCAL FILES...
[*]You will find folders containing the installed DLC.
[/olist]


These DLC files are not directly playable through Steam. To play them you will have to find an emulator, or transfer them to an appropriate machine.

notes.title: Now available in Japanese! (日本語)
notes.content:
Lizard is now available in six languages:

[list]
[*] English
[*] Français (French)
[*] Deutsch (German)
[*] Português do Brasil (Brazilian Portuguese)
[*] Español (Spanish)
[*] 日本語 (Japanese)
[/list]

These languages are also included with the optional DOS and NES DLC.

notes.title: NES ROM and DOS version now available as free DLC.
notes.content:
The NES ROM and DOS versions of Lizard are now available directly through Steam as free DLC.

[list][*]1. Go to the [b]Lizard[/b] game page of your Steam library.
[*]2. Scroll down to the DLC section, use the [b]checkbox[/b] to install the DLC.
[*]3. Right click on [b]Lizard[/b] in your games list, select [b]Properties[/b].
[*]4. Select the [b]LOCAL FILES[/b] tab.
[*]5. Click [b]BROWSE LOCAL FILES...[/b]
[*]6. You will find folders containing the installed DLC.[/list]

These DLC files are not directly playable through Steam. To play them you will have to find an emulator, or transfer them to an appropriate machine.
